Roadhog was immediately drawn to her free spirit and infectious personality. They started spending more and more time together, exploring the countryside and enjoying each other's company.

As they grew closer, Roadhog realized that he had developed feelings for Sprucebeef9. He was hesitant to share his feelings, as he had never been in love before, but he knew he couldn't keep them hidden forever.

One day, while sitting around a campfire, Roadhog finally mustered the courage to tell Sprucebeef9 how he felt. To his relief, she felt the same way about him. They shared a passionate kiss under the stars, sealing their love for each other.

From that moment on, Sprucebeef9 and Roadhog were inseparable. They continued their travels together, making memories and falling more in love with each passing day. They knew that they had found something special in each other, and that their love would only continue to grow stronger over time.

k2  2k = 0

either k = 0
not allowed (critical note, above)
